mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author, created_at FROM board_post ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT t.relname AS tableName, obj_description(t.oid) AS tableComment FROM pg_class t INNER JOIN pg_namespace n ON t.relnamespace = n.oid WHERE t.relkind = 'r' -- 'r'은 일반 테이블(ordinary table)을 의미 AND n.nspname = 'public' ORDER BY t.relname

SELECT c.column_name AS columnName, c.data_type AS dataType, c.is_nullable AS isNullable, c.column_default AS columnDefault, obj_description(t.oid) AS tableComment, col_description(t.oid, c.ordinal_position) AS columnComment FROM information_schema.columns c JOIN pg_class t ON t.relname = c.table_name WHERE c.table_name = #{tableName} AND c.table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position
